figurative_meaning_en: Savior of the fallen; God who rescues the downtrodden; Remover of calamities
example_sentences_in_bangla: বিপদের সময় ঈশ্বরই আমাদের অগতির গতি।
তিনি পতিতের অগতির গতি হিসেবে পরিচিত।
example_sentences_in_english: In times of distress, God is our refuge for the helpless.
He is known as the savior for the fallen.
history: This phrase is an epithet for Lord Krishna in Bengali Vaishnava literature, symbolizing divine protection for the helpless.
note: Derived from devotional contexts in Bengali culture
